canonical_project: PADEC secondary data centre upgrade ('mise a niveau du secondaire')
owner: Government of the Union of the Comoros via ANADEN; African Development Bank (AfDB) PADEC - P-KM-G00-001
notes: Lead (facility identity unverified). AfDB PADEC (Projet d'Appui a la Digitalisation de l'Economie Comorienne, approved 2024) procurement plan (PPM 2025-07-02) includes supply/install of equipment for a primary datacentre + digital incubator and 'mise a niveau du secondaire' (upgrade of a secondary datacentre). Candidate secondary facility unconfirmed: Comores Telecom server facility (HQ Place Volo-volo, Moroni) and/or a government IT facility. PADEC officially launched 27-28 Mar 2025 (ANADEN, A-grade). A-grade for AfDB financing scope; facility identity B/C until a primary source names it. No capacity data (null).
